sections.text:
1 Capita quae ff. 272-273 et 280-281 obtinent, et quorum index f. 282 praebetur,
ex Apomasaris, quae feruntur, collectaneis excerpta esse collato codice Floren-
tino 11 apparet. Quae omnia ex codice Angelicano 29, anni 1388, quo Apomasaris
opus exstat, fluxisse, ex fragmentis quae edemus veri fiet simile.
sections.en: 1 The chapters which ff. 272-273 and 280-281 contain, and whose index is provided on f. 282, appear to have been excerpted from the collections attributed to Apomasar, by comparison with the Florentine codex 11. That all these flowed from the Angelican codex 29, of the year 1388, in which the work of Apomasar is extant, will become likely from the fragments which we shall edit.

summary.headline: Apomasar Excerpts and Diagrams
summary.text: Catalogue of Bologna codex 18 materials, including astrological, astronomical, mathematical, chiromantic, and magical diagrams and notes, followed by Apomasar excerpts on chronocrators, lunar eclipses, the Cheiraneta, the Dog Star, weather, foundations, loans, theft, buying, letters, marriage, stolen goods, and treasures. The entries are cross-referenced to Florentine codex 11, with some marked for an appendix edition.
